name: jazz-life

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify app Client ID — set at https://github.com/settings/codespaces (User secrets) and grant repo access to jazz-life. Source: https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Spotify app Client Secret — set at https://github.com/settings/codespaces. Source: same Dashboard page as Client ID.

ALLOWED_SPOTIFY_USER_ID.description: Owner's Spotify user ID (login allowlist). The bit after open.spotify.com/user/.

JWT_SECRET.description: JWT signing key, 32+ chars. Generate: python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))'

REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY.description: Fernet key for encrypting Spotify refresh_token in DB. Generate: python -c 'from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())'

postCreateCommand: echo 'jazz-life devcontainer ready. run cd app && make up next.'
